type_schema.description:
NEAR Account Identifier.

This is a unique, syntactically valid, human-readable account identifier on the NEAR network.

[See the crate-level docs for information about validation.](index.html#account-id-rules)

Also see [Error kind precedence](AccountId#error-kind-precedence).

## Examples

``` use near_account_id::AccountId;

let alice: AccountId = "alice.near".parse().unwrap();

assert!("ƒelicia.near".parse::<AccountId>().is_err()); // (ƒ is not f) ```

token_interface.trust_limit: ABI does not prove token transfer behavior or absence of restrictions; remote code hash not atomically enforced by standard host interface.

existing_methods.name: create_payout
existing_methods.preconditions: Active, positive amounts, campaign input token, available
existing_methods.effect: Reserve only; identical idempotency reuse; no transfer

existing_methods.name: settle_payout
existing_methods.effect: Succeeded, reserved to spent; trusted attestation, no token proof

existing_methods.name: ft_on_transfer
existing_methods.preconditions: Approved campaign, matching token, budget headroom
existing_methods.effect: Credits funded, returns unused; no outgoing transfer

existing_limitations: No native transfer promises, withdrawal, rescue, native retry, state version or migration method.
Manual settlement and recovery trust privileged attestations.
Generic destination strings establish only nonblank values, not valid supported routes.
Legacy transient Authorized is not independent execution approval.
Current read-only service does not compose live worker/signer; 1Click dry-quote route does not execute this Testnet token.

proposed_architecture.custody: Contract-owned NEP141 balance until approved direct cross-contract ft_transfer. No wallet advance or Intents deposit.
proposed_architecture.coordination: Hybrid on-chain authority/callbacks, off-chain durable observation and independent finality verification.
interfaces: native views and separately specified dual-attestation resolution
proposed_architecture.legacy_guard_requirement: All legacy execution/failure/settlement/release/confirmation mutations reject native mode.
proposed_architecture.idempotency: Shared campaign/key index compares immutable full request AND mode. No legacy payout conversion.

authorization.approve: Explicit NativeApprover; distinct from reservation actor and executor
authorization.initiate: Explicit NativeExecutor plus unused bound independent approval
authorization.exceptional_resolution: Distinct explicit Verifier and NativeApprover attest same canonical evidence; neither reservation actor nor executor
authorization.governance: Owner, subject to root FullAccess deployment authority
authorization.approval_consumption: Atomic before first promise; new monotonic attempt and fresh approval per retry
authorization.database_controls: Supplementary snapshots, single-use records and lease fencing; never chain authority
authorization.ttl_policy: Bounded; concrete TTL unresolved; on-chain timestamp expiry rechecked before dispatch
authorization.identity_limit: Different account IDs do not prove different human controllers; operational independence must be verified.

state_machine.storage: Versioned sidecars; no legacy enum reorder/struct append
state_machine.unknown_policy: Preserve consumed locked attempt and reservation; no retry or release.
state_machine.late_callback: Same unresolved attempt may settle once from quarantine; conflicting finalized outcome freezes.

invariants: transfer amount equals immutable reserved payout input
no native access through legacy trusted manual settlement/release

reference_payout.custody_reconciliation: Pending delivered-but-unbooked debits remain reserved; reconcile across all campaigns without treating raw token balance as free allocation.

callback.success: Trusted standard ft_transfer receipt committed; unit return has no amount/bool to decode; once-only reserved to spent
callback.failure: Definitive token failure, reserve retained, no USDC refund transfer
callback.panic_oog_decode_failure: Token may have committed; preserve pending, no resend; evidence-based resolution
callback.pause_expiry: Block new dispatch, allow completion of existing attempt
callback.gas: Bounded/preallocated writes, measured worst-case promise graph required

failure_recovery.never_submitted: Re-read on-chain attempt before any resubmission
failure_recovery.definitive_failure: Finalized prior token receipt or definitive no-dispatch proof required, fresh independent approval/new attempt
failure_recovery.success_callback_lost: Resolve bookkeeping only; no second transfer
failure_recovery.refund: Failed standard ft_transfer atomically leaves USDC in source; no Intents refund policy
failure_recovery.trust_limit: Dual attestations are trusted, not cryptographically verified RPC receipt proofs on-chain; collusion can cause false retry.

requirements: AccountId syntax plus finalized account existence
NEP413 fresh nonce/domain/expiry and independent signature verification against current account key
On-chain recipient allowlist backed by evidence digest

settlement_verification.authoritative: Finalized exact trusted-token action/receipt graph and private callback state, cross-checked with independent RPC
settlement_verification.corroborative: Committed standard token log and same-block source/recipient balances with other movements attributed

migration.recommendation: Conditional Option A in-place isolated upgrade preserving old bytes, versioned unique sidecars, immutable mode guards; Option B separately funded new isolated fallback if preservation unproven.
migration.option_c: Auxiliary cannot spend source token balance without source upgrade or unsafe custody/root access; reject for initial demo.
migration.rollback: No automatic older-WASM redeployment or snapshot restore over external transfers; freeze, independently reconcile pending attempts, reviewed compatible forward fix.

threat_model.name: Unauthorized execution / compromised Operator
threat_model.scenario: Operator creates a payout and tries to execute without independent consent.
threat_model.mitigation: Explicit on-chain NativeApprover approval, separate actors, fixed reservation and NativeExecutor role; reject legacy bypass.
threat_model.residual_risk: Owner can change permissions; colluding principals remain trusted.
threat_model.required_test: No-role, Operator-only, self-approval and all legacy mutation bypass tests.

threat_model.name: Duplicate spend after callback loss
threat_model.scenario: Token delivered but callback panics; worker assumes failure and retries.
threat_model.preconditions: Successful token receipt with missing callback state.
threat_model.mitigation: Consume approval and lock attempt before promises; keep reserved; no timeout retry; dual evidence-based bookkeeping recovery.
threat_model.residual_risk: Colluding recovery attestors can falsely assert failure.
threat_model.required_test: Real transfer success plus callback panic/OOG, restart and attempted duplicate.

threat_model.name: Legacy manual settlement or release bypass
threat_model.scenario: Verifier settles nonexistent native delivery or releases an unresolved transfer.
threat_model.preconditions: Native payout accessible through legacy methods.
threat_model.impact: False spent or newly spendable delivered funds.
threat_model.mitigation: Immutable native mode; reject every legacy settlement/failure/release/execution-confirmation route for native records.
threat_model.residual_risk: Coverage omissions are catastrophic.
threat_model.required_test: Method-by-method negative matrix including paused and ManualReview paths.

threat_model.name: Unsafe migration / rollback
threat_model.scenario: Changed Borsh fields or old WASM ignores sidecar locks.
threat_model.impact: Lost state, lost replay protections, duplicate transfers.
threat_model.mitigation: Preserve old bytes, version sidecars, full snapshot fixtures, freeze and forward fix; no automatic rollback.
threat_model.residual_risk: Root deployer can install arbitrary code.
threat_model.required_test: Old snapshot including nonempty indexes; candidate/old-code behavioral compatibility tests.

threat_model.name: Root FullAccess compromise
threat_model.scenario: Account key signs direct token transfer or installs malicious WASM.
threat_model.mitigation: Exclude root keys from service, secure separately approved deployment process, monitor keys/code and freeze operations on drift.
threat_model.residual_risk: Cannot prevent root bypass while FullAccess remains; no permission change authorized now.
threat_model.required_test: Demonstrate trust boundary locally and reject service root-key configuration.

threat_model.name: Compromised execution service / API token
threat_model.scenario: Backend submits altered payout or fabricates job success.
threat_model.impact: Wrong recipient/payment or false UI settlement.
threat_model.mitigation: On-chain approval binding and roles, scoped future signer, chain-first reconciliation, readonly deployment kept separate.
threat_model.residual_risk: Compromised permitted executor can cause delay/gas spending within approvals.
threat_model.required_test: Alter each binding field, mock backend success without token receipt.

threat_model.name: Duplicate execution concurrency
threat_model.scenario: Two workers or retries race on same payout.
threat_model.preconditions: Lease expiry, restarted process or duplicate events.
threat_model.mitigation: Single on-chain active attempt and approval consumption; immutable mode/idempotency; DB fencing supplementary.
threat_model.residual_risk: Gas wasted on rejected calls.
threat_model.required_test: Concurrent execute calls, stale DB leases and auth consumption races.

threat_model.name: Callback spoofing / stale callback
threat_model.scenario: Attacker calls callback, or old attempt result targets new attempt.
threat_model.preconditions: Public callback or missing identity check.
threat_model.mitigation: Private predecessor=current; one result; payout/auth/attempt check and applied marker; preserve state on mismatch.
threat_model.residual_risk: Root self-call remains privileged; depends on deployment integrity.
threat_model.required_test: External/contract caller, wrong result count, wrong auth, stale and duplicate callbacks.

threat_model.name: Cross-contract interleaving
threat_model.scenario: Pause, another payout callback or campaign change occurs between receipts.
threat_model.impact: Stale accounting overwrite or unauthorized dispatch.
threat_model.mitigation: Persist lock first; reload current accounting; recheck before dispatch; allow safe completion while paused.
threat_model.residual_risk: Late callback may require review after governance changes.
threat_model.required_test: Interleave two payouts and campaigns, pause/revoke/expire between stages.

threat_model.name: Amount / token / decimals manipulation
threat_model.scenario: Alter expected output or token after approval.
threat_model.impact: Overpayment, wrong asset or misleading UI.
threat_model.mitigation: Strict native identity, same input/output atomic amount, decimals6, stored digest, no arbitrary execution args.
threat_model.residual_risk: Trusted token implementation can violate semantics.
threat_model.required_test: Token, amount, decimals, mode and output mismatch tests.

threat_model.name: Recipient substitution / false control
threat_model.scenario: Approved destination swapped or NEP413 replay used.
threat_model.preconditions: Mutable recipient or weak proof validation.
threat_model.mitigation: Immutable recipient, explicit allowlist, independent control proof/nonce/domain/expiry/current key membership and storage check.
threat_model.residual_risk: Key theft after proof; allowlist governance compromise.
threat_model.required_test: Mutation, replay, wrong account/key/domain/network and expired proof tests.

threat_model.name: Budget / cross-campaign bypass
threat_model.scenario: Pooled balance used to fund unfunded campaign or double reserve.
threat_model.mitigation: Checked invariant arithmetic, exact reservation amount and campaign binding; surplus not autoallocated.
threat_model.residual_risk: Out-of-band root or token movements can break custody.
threat_model.required_test: Boundary u128, exhausted budget, multiple payouts/campaigns and unsolicited token surplus.

threat_model.name: Incorrect evidence / colluding recovery
threat_model.scenario: Hash/log/balance accepted as proof, or false nonsettlement attested.
threat_model.impact: Double payment or false terminal state.
threat_model.mitigation: Canonical finalized receipt graph from two RPCs, exact binding, two distinct attestors, no unresolved retry/release.
threat_model.residual_risk: Attestation is trusted, not on-chain cryptographic receipt verification.
threat_model.required_test: Forged hash/log, missing receipt, conflicting RPCs, same-person dual approval.

threat_model.name: Token failure or malicious upgrade
threat_model.scenario: Token rejects storage/transfer, freezes accounts or returns success without transfer.
threat_model.impact: Frozen funds or falsely recorded delivery.
threat_model.mitigation: Pinned account and monitored code identity, source/conformance gate; reject upgrades/drift; bounded failure handling.
threat_model.residual_risk: No atomic remote code-hash pin; token governance remains trusted.
threat_model.required_test: Mock reject/no-op/nonstandard return and upgrade-between-preflight tests.

threat_model.name: Callback gas/storage exhaustion
threat_model.scenario: Token commits but callback lacks gas or storage balance.
threat_model.mitigation: Bounded preallocated records, measured gas margins, minimum prepaid guards; preserve attempt and review on callback loss.
threat_model.residual_risk: No retroactive gas top-up; liveness can stop.
threat_model.required_test: Real sandbox OOG/storage pressure plus no-resend assertions.

threat_model.name: RPC inconsistency / timeout
threat_model.scenario: Timeout interpreted as failed submission.
threat_model.mitigation: Pinned finalized block, two endpoints, canonical receipt traversal; timeout→unknown.
threat_model.residual_risk: Two endpoints may share infrastructure; no light-client proof.
threat_model.required_test: Timeout before/after submission, divergent endpoints and missing history.

threat_model.name: Database crash / restart / stale lease
threat_model.scenario: Crash after chain dispatch but before DB commit.
threat_model.mitigation: Chain attempt authority, durable outbox/attempt intent with fences, replayable discovery, resume observation not transfer.
threat_model.residual_risk: Manual intervention may be required; DB durability not chain authority.
threat_model.required_test: Real PostgreSQL crash-boundary and lease-expiry concurrent-worker tests.

threat_model.name: Accidental mainnet execution
threat_model.scenario: Signer or RPC configuration points to mainnet.
threat_model.mitigation: Configured chain/genesis and exact isolated account/token assertions, Testnet-only mode; no arbitrary network field.
threat_model.residual_risk: Root administrator can change config/build.
threat_model.required_test: Wrong genesis/RPC/account/token fail closed before signing.

threat_model.name: Missing or changed recipient storage
threat_model.scenario: Registration disappears after check.
threat_model.preconditions: Recipient unregisters or unsupported storage implementation.
threat_model.mitigation: Separate approved registration, storage callback then trusted atomic token failure handling.
threat_model.residual_risk: TOCTOU cannot be eliminated by preflight alone.
threat_model.required_test: Missing storage, malformed view and unregister interleaving integration tests.

threat_model.name: Pause / expiry denial of safe completion
threat_model.scenario: Global pause blocks a success callback.
threat_model.preconditions: Shared pause guard copied into callback.
threat_model.mitigation: Block new initiation and storage-stage dispatch, not settlement of existing attempt.
threat_model.residual_risk: Recovery may still need humans after callback failure.
threat_model.required_test: Pause/expiry/token delist immediately before final callback.

threat_model.name: Dashboard presents reservation as payment
threat_model.scenario: List is stale or DB job says success with no canonical proof.
threat_model.mitigation: Separate reservation, dispatch, delivery and settlement; show evidence/lag; chain status authoritative.
threat_model.residual_risk: Read-only list depends on persisted job discovery.
threat_model.required_test: Direct detail versus lagging list, missing evidence and conflicting DB status tests.

test_matrix.cases: Token success/no-op or upgraded/nonstandard mock, storage unregister race

test_matrix.cases: Exact current old snapshot plus synthetic nonempty legacy evidence/indexes

test_matrix.cases: Crash before send, after send before DB commit, after callback before evidence persistence
test_matrix.acceptance: Restart monitors same attempt; never sends token twice; cursor/job commit atomic.

test_matrix.cases: RPC timeout, stale/conflicting endpoints, missing receipt, forged log/hash, settlement evidence integrity
test_matrix.acceptance: Unknown→ManualReview; exact finalized action graph required, balances corroborative only.

test_matrix.cases: Native mode routing, native no-refund policy, direct detail and persisted-list lag
test_matrix.acceptance: No 1Click quote/deposit; truthful status and scope; no arbitrary signer capability.

test_matrix.cases: Restricted read-only startup and denied mutation/worker/signer composition
test_matrix.acceptance: Current environment stays read-only, no schema migration/DB writes/live signer.

test_matrix.cases: NEP413 nonce/domain/expiry/account/key-membership and registration/balance fixture
test_matrix.acceptance: Reject replay/wrong account; no invented recipient or implicit allowlist grant.

test_matrix.cases: Deployment, identity/state verification, recipient, reserve, approve, execute, receipts, accounting/dashboard
test_matrix.acceptance: Every state-changing step has separate exact approval; one 100000-atomic payment only.
